notice.beta: Beta data: WoW: Forever beta build {build}. Forever launches on 2026-11-05; the data will be refreshed for the live game.
notice.derived: Generated from the game client's data tables. Nothing here is confirmed by Blizzard.
notice.prices: Prices come only from your own Auctionator file and the prices you type. Nothing is uploaded.

coverage.sources: Recipe sources for levels 1-30 (Alliance) are curated from public sources and in-game checks. Above 30, and for the Horde, most sources are derived from the game data and marked "source unknown" or "from game data".
coverage.horde: Horde recipe vendors are mostly unknown; Horde sources mirror the Alliance ones where the patterns match and are marked unverified.
coverage.unknown: "Source unknown" recipes still count as available. Switch on "Only recipes with a known source" to hide them.

notes: Stats are RandPropPoints[item level][quality][slot] x stat share / 10000, the game's own budget formula.

Weapon damage follows the damage tables, checked against in-game tooltips: caster weapons (a flag in the item data) deal 2/3 of the one-hand table or about 26% less than the two-hand table; bows, guns and crossbows use the two-hand table x 0.6, thrown weapons the one-hand table x 0.9. The bomb satchels carry part of their damage in an explosion effect; their damage is taken from the tooltip.
Mail and plate are assumed to become wearable at level 40, as in vanilla. This is not yet verified for Forever.
Trainer recipe skill is approximate (~): the game data gives only the rank where a recipe turns yellow.
